name: Pad See Ew
assumptions: Recipe is for 2 servings based on typical Pad See Ew portions (180g dry noodles + 140g chicken for 2 adults).
Preparation time estimated from stir-fry instructions (sauce mix ~2 min, high-heat cooking sequence ~10-12 min total).
Oyster sauce classified as containing shellfish (true) and ambiguous on fish (null).
Dark/regular soy sauces classified as containing wheat and soy (true).
Peanut oil classified as containing peanuts (true).
No dairy ingredients present (Dairy-free true, Milk false).
Chinese broccoli, garlic, sugar, vinegar, water, and rice noodles introduce no additional allergens or diet conflicts under conservative screening.
instructions:
Mix Sauce in small bowl.
Mince garlic into wok with oil. Place over high heat, when hot, add chicken and Chinese broccoli stems, cook until chicken is light golden.
Push to the side of the wok, crack egg in and scramble. Don't worry if it sticks to the bottom of the wok - it will char and which adds authentic flavour.
Add noodles, Chinese broccoli leaves and sauce. Gently mix together until the noodles are stained dark and leaves are wilted. Serve immediately!
